import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/test_0.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target,
# and target schema is ['condition': integer, 'click': float],
# we can union (concatenate) all source tables.

# Concatenate all source DataFrames
combined_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the data types match the target schema
combined_df['condition'] = combined_df['condition'].astype(int)
combined_df['click'] = combined_df['click'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
